capabilities.description: Builds and certifies interim progress claims against BOQ items, applies the contract's retention and performance-security rules, and issues payment certificates that reconcile measured quantities to the BOQ of record.
requirements: Use the uploaded contract and BOQ as the source of record
Clause 14.3 Retention: 5% of each Interim Payment Certificate, released 50% at Taking-Over and 50% at the end of the Defects Notification Period.
Clause 4.2 Performance Security: 10% of the Accepted Contract Amount.

capabilities.description: Tracks the 730-day Time for Completion from the Commencement Date, computes delay days, applies delay damages at 0.1% of the Accepted Contract Amount per day with a 10% cap, and records the running deduction against each payment certificate.
requirements: Clause 8.2  Time for Completion: 730 days from the Commencement Date.
Clause 8.7  Delay Damages: 0.1% of the Accepted Contract Amount per day of delay, capped at 10% of the Accepted Contract Amount.

capabilities.description: Captures inspection-and-test-plan records for earthworks and other BOQ work, holds them against the relevant BOQ item and clause (including the Clause 11.1 Defects Notification Period), and locks QA evidence so it cannot be edited after certification.
requirements: Use the uploaded contract and BOQ as the source of record
Clause 11.1 Defects Notification Period: 365 days from Taking-Over.

capabilities.description: Maintains a controlled register of the uploaded contract and BOQ and all subsequent project documents, with versioning, provenance, and retrieval so any claim, delay-damages figure, or QA record cites document:<filename> as its source.
requirements: Use the uploaded contract and BOQ as the source of record

capabilities.description: Measures progress against each BOQ line (Preliminaries, Earthworks) using the uploaded harbourline_boq.xlsx quantities and rates, computes value to date per item, and feeds certified quantities into progress claims.
requirements: Use the uploaded contract and BOQ as the source of record

capabilities.description: Gives contract administrators a single view of claim status, delay-damages exposure against the 10% cap, open QA/ITP items, and controlled documents, with drill-through to the governing clause or document.
